* [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Light Character: Echo Base Trooper, Hoth, C3
|strategy=By Carl 'Mike' Hardy, Red 32

A specialized trooper, this guy really works well in the winter wonderland of [[Hoth (location){{!}}Hoth]].

The good points are, he's got better power and better forfeit than your average [[Rebel Trooper]]. This makes these guys a better choice for duking

it out in the snow trenches. They've also got a good destiny draw (3), a considerable advantage over the [[Rebel Trooper]]'s obscene 1 destiny.

The bad points; they are a little more expensive than the [[Rebel Trooper]], but that's nothing that a [[Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker){{!}}Hoth: Defensive Perimeter]] or [[Echo Base Trooper Officer]] can't fix, each reducing their deploy cost by -1. There's also the fact that they are kind of specialized; these guys can only deploy on [[Hoth (location){{!}}Hoth]], and on non-[[Hoth (location){{!}}Hoth]] sites, their power becomes the equivalent of the lowly [[Rebel Trooper]]. So, you might not want to go any place else with these guys.

All-in-all, you've got yourself a nicely powered character, that's got a

good destiny and doesn't cost an arm and a leg.

Red 32's combos:

- Hurry up and get those troopers down before somebody Monnocks

you!

- Can you say free deploying power 5 characters at same site... power 4 at adjacent sites? Aaiiiyeeee!
|combos=* [[Echo Base Trooper]] + [[Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker){{!}}Hoth: Defensive Perimeter]] + [[Echo Base Trooper Officer]]
* Echo Base Troopers + [[General Carlist Rieekan]] + any [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]] + [[Leia Of Alderaan]]
